package main

import (
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"

	v1 "${APP_NAME}/handlers/api/v1"
	"${APP_NAME}/middleware"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/jimmitjoo/tjo/api"
)

// The API, and its description.
//
// Each route is registered with api.Describe, so the same declaration that
// documents an operation is the one the router sees. There is no build step and
// no annotation comments: openAPIDocument below is generated by walking the
// routes that were actually registered.
//
// A declaration can still drift from what its handler writes, which is what
// routes-api_test.go checks.

var listResourcesOp = api.Op{
	Summary:     "List resources",
	Description: "Returns a page of resources.",
	Tags:        []string{"resources"},
	Params: []api.Parameter{
		{Name: "page", Description: "Page number, from 1", Type: 0, Example: 1},
		{Name: "per_page", Description: "Items per page, at most 100", Type: 0, Example: 20},
	},
	Response: v1.ListResponse{},
	Errors:   []int{http.StatusUnauthorized},
}

var getResourceOp = api.Op{
	Summary:  "Fetch a resource",
	Tags:     []string{"resources"},
	Response: v1.Resource{},
	Errors:   []int{http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusUnauthorized, http.StatusNotFound},
}

var createResourceOp = api.Op{
	Summary:  "Create a resource",
	Tags:     []string{"resources"},
	Request:  v1.CreateResourceRequest{},
	Response: v1.Resource{},
	Status:   http.StatusCreated,
	Errors:   []int{http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusUnauthorized},
}

var updateResourceOp = api.Op{
	Summary:  "Replace a resource",
	Tags:     []string{"resources"},
	Request:  v1.CreateResourceRequest{},
	Response: v1.Resource{},
	Errors:   []int{http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusUnauthorized},
}

var deleteResourceOp = api.Op{
	Summary: "Delete a resource",
	Tags:    []string{"resources"},
	Errors:  []int{http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusUnauthorized},
}

var loginOp = api.Op{
	Summary:  "Sign in and receive a token",
	Tags:     []string{"auth"},
	Request:  v1.LoginRequest{},
	Response: v1.LoginResponse{},
	Errors:   []int{http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusUnauthorized},
}

var refreshOp = api.Op{
	Summary:  "Exchange a token for a fresh one",
	Tags:     []string{"auth"},
	Response: v1.LoginResponse{},
	Errors:   []int{http.StatusUnauthorized},
}

// apiInfo is the document's metadata.
var apiInfo = api.Info{
	Title:       "${APP_NAME} API",
	Version:     "1.0.0",
	Description: "Generated from the routes this application registers.",
}

// apiRoutes sets up API routes with versioning
func apiRoutes(mux *chi.Mux) {
	jwtSecret := os.Getenv("JWT_SECRET")
	if jwtSecret == "" {
		jwtSecret = "your-secret-key-change-in-production"
	}

	authHandler := &v1.AuthHandler{JWTSecret: jwtSecret}
	resourceHandler := &v1.ResourceHandler{}

	// API v1 routes
	mux.Route("/api/v1", func(r chi.Router) {
		// CORS for API
		r.Use(middleware.CORS([]string{"*"}))

		// Public routes.
		//
		// Method rather than Post, because a described handler is an
		// http.Handler and chi's verb helpers take an http.HandlerFunc.
		r.Method("POST", "/auth/login", api.Describe(loginOp, authHandler.Login))

		// Protected routes
		r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
			r.Use(middleware.JWTAuth(jwtSecret))

			// Token refresh
			r.Method("POST", "/auth/refresh", api.Describe(refreshOp, authHandler.Refresh))

			// Resources CRUD
			r.Method("GET", "/resources", api.Describe(listResourcesOp, resourceHandler.List))
			r.Method("POST", "/resources", api.Describe(createResourceOp, resourceHandler.Create))
			r.Method("GET", "/resources/{id}", api.Describe(getResourceOp, resourceHandler.Get))
			r.Method("PUT", "/resources/{id}", api.Describe(updateResourceOp, resourceHandler.Update))
			r.Method("DELETE", "/resources/{id}", api.Describe(deleteResourceOp, resourceHandler.Delete))
		})
	})

	// The OpenAPI document is deliberately not mounted.
	//
	// It is a map of the attack surface -- every path, every parameter, every
	// field name -- so publishing it is a decision rather than a default, the
	// same rule the ops dashboard follows. Uncomment this behind whatever
	// authorisation the rest of your admin surface uses, or serve it only when
	// DEBUG is set:
	//
	//	mux.Method("GET", "/openapi.json", openAPIDocument(mux))
}

// openAPIDocument builds the handler that serves the document.
//
// Built once, from the routes that were registered, so it cannot describe an
// endpoint that does not exist or miss one that does.
func openAPIDocument(routes chi.Routes) http.Handler {
	handler, err := api.OpenAPIHandler(routes, apiInfo)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("building the OpenAPI document: %v", err)
	}
	return handler
}
